purpose: Public creator pattern hypotheses. These are patterns to test, not templates to copy.
source_policy: Use public observations as hypotheses; never copy wording, distinctive style, identity, branding or media.

patterns.hypothesis: A concrete question with two defensible choices lowers reply effort and can outperform generic opinion prompts.
patterns.test: End one post with a binary or two-option question.

patterns.pattern: Fast reaction to a verified catalyst
patterns.hypothesis: Timely reaction to a real event can create more discussion than a generic price recap.
patterns.test: Use a verified news catalyst and explain one consequence in plain language.

patterns.hypothesis: Showing real market structure and asking readers to choose breakout/fakeout or continuation/reversal may increase interaction.
patterns.test: Use a real 1h chart and mark only observed levels.

patterns.hypothesis: Readers may be more curious about unusual market events than routine BTC recaps.
patterns.test: Rotate gainers, losers, volume spikes, new listings and volatility events.

patterns.hypothesis: A simple comparison creates a natural side-taking decision.
patterns.test: Compare two liquid assets using one clear metric and ask which has the stronger setup.

patterns.hypothesis: An unexpected verified statistic can create curiosity without relying on hype.
patterns.test: Lead with one unusual number and explain why it matters.

patterns.hypothesis: A concise post paired with a truthful chart can communicate faster than a long technical report.
patterns.test: Keep the caption compact and let the chart carry part of the explanation.

patterns.hypothesis: Binance says Write to Earn attribution can use coin cashtags or chart widgets when readers subsequently trade.
patterns.test: Use the primary asset cashtag naturally and a truthful chart when relevant.
